(Cuentan con comida vegana y libre de gluten). ¡A﻿nimaros!. Aparte de conocernos en persona, ¡Habrá sorpresas! About the event (in English) Hello everyone! On August 28th we will celebrate a meeting of the Spanish-speaking Radix Community in Madrid. At the Cink Coworking facilities at Calle Henri Dunant 15/17. The plan we have is as follows: 1:00 a.m. Inscription 1:30 a.m. Introduction to Radix 1:15 a.m. Coffee 11:30 a.m. Smart contracts and Scrypto 2:30 p.m. Projects about Scrypto 13:30 a.m. Closing For later, around 2:30 p.m. those who want, we will have lunch together at the "Comic Planet" Restaurant located at Av. ALCOCER 5 Ade Madrid. (They have vegan and gluten-free food). Apart from meeting in person, there will be surprises so Cheer up!
